data.name: omgskills
data.description: Search the omgskills open library of agent skills.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search skills by keywords or a short task, with typo correction and optional author, tag and minimum-star filters.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Get one skill by ID, with install status, a pinned install plan and per-agent install scripts.

tools.name: get_skills
tools.description: Get up to 30 skills by ID in one read, listing any that were not found.

tools.name: list_trending
tools.description: List skills ordered by the current omgskills trending ranking.

tools.name: list_gold_basket
tools.description: List curated Gold Basket skills ordered by editorial score.

tools.name: list_by_author
tools.description: List skills published by a GitHub author handle.

tools.name: related_skills
tools.description: Find other skills for the same job, useful for pinned alternatives.

tools.name: get_install_plan
tools.description: Get commit-pinned install steps for Claude Code or Codex that verify SKILL.md.

tools.name: get_skill_content
tools.description: Read a skill's SKILL.md from GitHub at its pinned commit and check it against the catalog hash.

entries.description: Read-only MCP server for discovering and inspecting public agent skills in the omgskills library. No sign-in.
representativeQueries: install a skill for React performance in Codex
show the current trending agent skills
list curated skills from trusted sources

data.name: omgskills-my-skills
data.description: Search and read the signed-in user's own skills in omgskills (My skills).

tools.name: search_my_skills
tools.description: List or search the user's own skills: personal skills and library skills they installed or added.

tools.name: read_my_skill
tools.description: Read one skill from My skills by ID: its SKILL.md and a list of its other files.

tools.name: read_skill_file
tools.description: Read one other file of a skill in My skills, by skill ID and file path.

entries.description: Read-only MCP server that lets an agent the user connects and allows read that user's own skills. Requires signing in to omgskills.
